headline: IDEX (IEX) Stock Trades At A Discount On Cash Flow But A Premium On Earnings
summary: IDEX has risen 24.7% year to date, yet its valuation signals are split, with an intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model pointing to upside while earnings based multiples lean the other way. The 24.7% year to date gain suggests investors have been willing to pay a richer price for IDEX shares in a relatively short period.
